results.rationale: Consistency: bottle shape, red capsule and label layout remain, but the main label lettering changes from red/black to gold. Instruction: upright bottle, red-black spotlight gradient, restrained composition, bottom reflection and upper-right gold phrase are present; the typography is flowing script rather than the requested serif. Quality: bottle, lighting, reflections and lettering form a coherent polished advertisement without noticeable artifacts.

Consistency: white cat pose, facial identity and paws remain recognizable, but fur and facial texture are noticeably altered. Instruction: pink-blue gradient, paws, hearts and bright pink Pet Home are present; the cat is reduced rather than slightly enlarged, and the tagline is dark italic text beside its head instead of light-grey minimalist text below. Quality: overall poster and cat anatomy are coherent, with one small malformed partial decorative mark at the bottom.
